svg.text: EA Command & Conquer / Red Alert — OpenTS / OpenRA / Chrono Divide
Official games, source status & community rebuilding paths (as of 2026)
Tiberian Sun / Firestorm = OpenTS's main targets
Red Alert 2 / Yuri's Revenge = Chrono Divide compatibility targets (currently vanilla RA2)
Mod assets for C&C3 / RA3 / C&C4:
Renderer: bgfx | Uses EA source code: Yes
Built on related C&C source released by EA under the GPL
Also reverse-engineers the original Tiberian Sun executable
High fidelity, original behavior, standalone executable engine
A modern RTS engine reimagining the classics
Games: Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn, Dune 2000
Separate community efforts also explore RA2
Cross-platform | Directly reuses EA source: No
OpenRA's engine was built from scratch
Later EA RA1 / TD source releases serve as implementation references
No direct inheritance of EA code | Approach: reimagining
Modern controls, multiplayer, balance and mods; not a 1:1 recreation
Red Alert 2 rebuilt for the browser
Status: playable beta (LAN / online) | Target: vanilla Red Alert 2
Runs in a browser | Uses EA source code: No
Recreates RA2's engine, aiming for feature parity with vanilla RA2
Broad compatibility with original RA2 1.006 mods
Yuri's Revenge mods are NOT compatible
Client engine not fully open source; public code is mainly SDK / API / tools
Focus: compatibility, easy setup, cross-platform web access
